NewsArticle.Title: Now Hiring
NewsArticle.Content: Nexon Inc. is a developer of massive multiplayer online RPGs for PCs. Since its founding in 1994, Nexon has set many records, including creation of the first fully-scalable graphical online world. While competitors try to make online games stay online, Nexon creates the next generation of online entertainment. Nexon is currently seeking motivated and talented people. Our studio is located in the heart of Silicon Valley: Sunnyvale, California. We offer stock options and a comprehensive health benefit plan. A challenging career in a friendly atmosphere awaits. Game Operator - Gaming expertise - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Unix literacy Quality Assurance Specialist - Testing expertise; attention to detail - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Unix and database literacy Contact Info: If you are interested in one of the above positions, please send your resume and salary history to: Nexon Inc. Attn.: Recruiting 2855 Kifer Road Suite 100 Santa Clara, CA 95051 Fax: 408-988-7677 Email your resume Please check out our web-site to learn more at [www.nexon.net](http://www.nexon.net/). Nexon is an equal opportunity employer.
